parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the basic principles of CT scanning (computed tomography).

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: By reference to your answer in (a), suggest why
parts.text: CT scanning was not possible before fast computers with large memories were available,

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the radiation dose for a CT scan is much larger than for an X-ray image of a leg bone.
